resolution: Root cause (user's bisection nailed it): the hmsc-int editor opened to the React Scene3D iso view (IsoAuthor), which rebuilt the entire 'main' map (3594 pieces) every boot and shipped ~683MB across the JS->host bridge — measured via a new on-demand transfer probe ('I MADE IT' button + __flushReport/__storeReadReport meters). On the big 'main' map that meant ~30s startup with no window AND a blank/failed render (GPU instance overflow); small maps were instant. Fix: render the build pane with the NATIVE world_loader (the compiled game's loader — one gamefile read, no React Scene3D) via a new LoaderIsoView + an external-camera door in world_loader.zig (setExternalCamera + a pending-camera table applied every renderEmbedded frame) + V8 doors __compiled_world_set_camera/_clear_camera. Made it the DEFAULT boot (persisted toggle to opt back to React). USER CONFIRMED: startup 30s -> 3s and the world renders. Remaining (separate reqs): camera polish (req_1769), per-map gamefile + debounced auto-compile (req_1760/1761), picking/placement in the loader pane.
